facts.text: 发行商Sekai Project于11月10日宣布，系列最终章《KARAKARA 3》将于11月23日登陆Steam，售价9.99美元。开发商为calme。

evidence.quote: The final chapter in the KARAKARA series, KARAKARA 3 is coming to Steam this winter!
Developer: calme Platform: Steam Price: $9.99 Releae Date: November 23, 2026

facts.text: 故事设定在人类衰退的“黄昏时代”，莱昂与露西亚在干旱土地上经营小餐馆。本作中，莱昂接到一通来自旧时代遗物的电话，得知镇治安队成员卡伦被挟持。

evidence.quote: The “Age of Dusk.” It is a time of senescence for the human species, during which hybrids known as the “Others”—those who are human, yet not—exist in great numbers.
Leon and Lucia, who run a small diner.
Leon hears the sound of a telephone, a Relic from the past and is informed that Cullen, a member of the town vigilante corp, is being held hostage.

facts.text: 公告称，本作最早在2018年Anime Weekend Atlanta公布，插画由日本角色设计师p19绘制。

evidence.quote: First announced during Anime Weekend Atlanta in 2018, KARAKARA 3 is the concluding chapter in the KARAKARA trilogy featuring the beautiful illustrations of Japanese character designer, p19.

bilingual.title_en: KARAKARA 3, Series Finale, Set for Steam Launch on November 23

sentences.en: Publisher Sekai Project announced on November 10 that KARAKARA 3, the final chapter of the series, will launch on Steam on November 23 at $9.99.
sentences.zh: 发行商Sekai Project于11月10日宣布，系列最终章《KARAKARA 3》将于11月23日登陆Steam，售价9.99美元。

sentences.en: The story is set in the "Twilight Age" of human decline, where Leon and Lucia run a small restaurant on arid land.
sentences.zh: 故事设定在人类衰退的“黄昏时代”，莱昂与露西亚在干旱土地上经营小餐馆。

sentences.en: In this game, Leon receives a phone call from a relic of the old era and learns that Karen, a member of the town's security team, has been taken hostage.
sentences.zh: 本作中，莱昂接到一通来自旧时代遗物的电话，得知镇治安队成员卡伦被挟持。

sentences.en: The announcement states that the game was first announced at Anime Weekend Atlanta in 2018 and that its illustrations are by Japanese character designer p19.
sentences.zh: 公告称，本作最早在2018年Anime Weekend Atlanta公布，插画由日本角色设计师p19绘制。
